edge.trigger: An outbox/notification endpoint is called by a role without chat permission, or the SMTP adapter only supports the existing inquiry format
edge.expect: The server rejects unauthorized access. New notification jobs use an independent restricted entry and a verified adapter contract. Do not let chatMessageId spread into the existing mail UI. The cron template must actually register the job and verify consumption after restart.

modules.M2: Products/3D: lists/cards/details, direct model input, touch/keyboard, image fallback, contextual inquiry.
modules.M3: Admin access/accounts: login/shell/settings, device sessions, authenticator/mode, revocation/restricted recovery.
modules.M4: First-party human chat: visitor session, messages/offline, ADMIN/SALES inbox/replies, unread/draft/retry, receipt/notification.
modules.M5: Consent/statistics ledger: anonymous IDs/events, admission/dedup, site timezone, daily/product aggregates, retention/recompute.
modules.M6: Business/ops dashboard: role-filtered real sources; distinguish data time, zero/no-data/unconnected/error/stale.
modules.M7: Integration/delivery: real cross-module visitor/admin/recovery/statistics/reliability acceptance evidence; safe recovered-source reuse.
